# Bid Manager — LLM Context File

> This file follows the [llms.txt convention](https://llmstxt.org) and is
> intended to give AI assistants a fast, accurate mental model of this project.

---

## Project Purpose

**Bid Manager** is a NestJS application that automates Amazon Sponsored Products
(SP) campaign optimization. It syncs campaign data from the Amazon Advertising
API, analyses performance metrics, and auto-applies bid and budget adjustments
— all driven by a deterministic rule engine derived from SRS documents.

---

## Technology Stack

| Layer | Choice |
|---|---|
| Runtime | Node.js + TypeScript 5 |
| Framework | NestJS 11 |
| Database | MongoDB via Mongoose 8 |
| Job queue | BullMQ 5 (Redis-backed) |
| Scheduler | @nestjs/schedule (node-cron) |
| HTTP client | Axios |
| Template engine | EJS (server-rendered dashboard) |
| Docs | VitePress + vitepress-plugin-mermaid |

---

## Repository Layout

```
src/
├── config/
│   └── configuration.ts          # Typed config factory (loaded by ConfigModule)
│
├── common/
│   ├── guards/
│   │   └── auth.guard.ts         # Global session-based AuthGuard
│   ├── filters/
│   │   └── http-exception.filter.ts  # Global exception → JSON error response
│   └── interceptors/
│       └── response.interceptor.ts   # Wraps /api/* responses in { success, data, timestamp }
│
├── modules/
│   └── optimization/
│       └── optimization.service.ts   # Core orchestrator: engines → decisions → Amazon API
│
├── engine/                        # Six deterministic @Injectable engines
│   ├── engine.module.ts           # EngineModule — provides & exports all six engines
│   ├── interfaces.ts              # ICampaignBundle, keywordWithReport
│   ├── acos-roas.engine.ts        # ACOS/ROAS zone detection & action table
│   ├── budget.engine.ts           # Budget increase / decrease decisions
│   ├── auto-campaign.engine.ts    # Auto campaign signal detection & actions
│   ├── bid-adjustment.engine.ts   # Keyword/target bid decisions
│   ├── keyword-targeting.engine.ts# Match-type graduation & negative rules
│   └── monitoring.engine.ts       # Applicable monitoring windows (1d/3d/7d/14d/30d)
│
├── services/
│   ├── auth.service.ts            # Amazon OAuth flow
│   ├── campaign.service.ts        # Campaign + bundle queries (MongoDB aggregation)
│   ├── report.service.ts          # Report bulk-upsert logic
│   ├── cron.service.ts            # Scheduled sync (02:00 UTC) & reports (06:00 UTC)
│   └── amazon/
│       ├── amazon-api.service.ts  # Base Axios client — auto token refresh, scope headers
│       ├── amazon-sync.service.ts # Full entity sync (campaigns, adGroups, keywords, targets)
│       ├── campaign-api.service.ts# Campaign list/update + budget-usage API
│       └── adgroup-api.service.ts # AdGroup, keyword & target CRUD + report generation
│
├── queue/
│   ├── producer/
│   │   ├── sync.producer.ts       # Enqueue campaignSync jobs
│   │   ├── report.producer.ts     # Enqueue reportProcessor jobs (20 retries, 2-min backoff)
│   │   └── bid.producer.ts        # Enqueue bidProcessor jobs per campaign
│   └── consumer/
│       ├── amazon-sync.processor.ts  # Pulls entity data from Amazon → MongoDB
│       ├── report.processor.ts       # Downloads gzipped report → parses → triggers bid queue
│       └── bid.processor.ts          # Calls OptimizationService per campaign
│
├── controllers/
│   ├── auth.controller.ts         # /auth — OAuth login, callback, logout
│   ├── campaign.controller.ts     # /api/campaigns — REST API
│   ├── profile.controller.ts      # /profiles — profile list & detail
│   └── view.controller.ts         # / /campaigns /logs — EJS-rendered dashboard pages
│
├── schemas/                       # Mongoose schema definitions
│   ├── campaign.schema.ts
│   ├── ad-group.schema.ts
│   ├── ad.schema.ts
│   ├── keyword.schema.ts
│   ├── target.schema.ts
│   ├── profile.schema.ts
│   ├── bid-adjustment-log.schema.ts
│   ├── optimization.schema.ts     # Audit log for every bid/budget change
│   └── reports/
│       ├── report.schema.ts       # Daily campaign report
│       ├── keyword-report.schema.ts
│       └── search-term-report.schema.ts
│
├── utils/
│   └── constant.ts                # REASON strings, threshold percentages
│
└── app.module.ts                  # Root module — wires everything together

docs/                              # VitePress documentation site
├── SRS/                           # Source SRS .docx files (read-only reference)
├── *-diagram.md                   # Mermaid flowcharts generated from SRS docs
├── quickstart.md
├── amazon-api-setup.md
└── index.md

.vitepress/config.mts              # VitePress + mermaid config (srcDir: ./docs)
```

---

## Key Data Flow

```
Cron (02:00 UTC)
  └─► SyncProducer → campaignSync queue
        └─► AmazonSyncProcessor → fetches entities from Amazon API → MongoDB

Cron (06:00 UTC)
  └─► ReportProducer → reportProcessor queue
        └─► ReportProcessor
              ├─ polls Amazon report until COMPLETED
              ├─ downloads gzipped JSON → saves to MongoDB
              └─► BidProducer → bidProcessor queue (one job per campaign)
                    └─► BidProcessor
                          ├─ loads CampaignBundle from MongoDB
                          └─► OptimizationService.optimizeCampaign()
                                ├─ AcosRoasEngine   (zone detection)
                                ├─ BudgetEngine     (budget increase/decrease)
                                ├─ AutoCampaignEngine or BidAdjustmentEngine
                                ├─ KeywordTargetingEngine (match-type graduation)
                                ├─ → CampaignApiService.updateCampaign() / updateKeyword()
                                └─ → OptimizationLog (MongoDB audit trail)
```

---

## Engine Summary

| Engine | Input | Output |
|---|---|---|
| `AcosRoasEngine` | spend, sales, clicks, impressions, netMargin, dataWindowDays | ACOS zone (PROFITABLE/OPTIMIZATION/RISK/NO_SALES) + action list |
| `BudgetEngine` | currentBudget, dailySpend, sales, ACOS, targetAcos | INCREASE/DECREASE/HOLD + newBudget |
| `AutoCampaignEngine` | spend, sales, clicks, ACOS, conversionRate, budgetUtilization | bidDecision + budgetDecision + moveTermsToManual flag |
| `BidAdjustmentEngine` | ACOS, clicks, sales, spend, impressions, targetAcos | INCREASE/DECREASE/PAUSE + adjustmentPct |
| `KeywordTargetingEngine` | clicks, spend, sales, ACOS, matchType, flags | actions[] (PAUSE, ADD_EXACT, MOVE_TO_MANUAL…) |
| `MonitoringEngine` | dataAgeDays | Applicable windows: 1d, 3d, 7d, 14d, 30d |

---

## Environment Variables

| Variable | Purpose | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `MONGODB_URI` | MongoDB connection string | `mongodb://localhost:27017/bid-manager` |
| `REDIS_HOST` / `REDIS_PORT` | BullMQ Redis connection | `localhost:6379` |
| `AMAZON_CLIENT_ID` | SP API OAuth client ID | — |
| `AMAZON_CLIENT_SECRET` | SP API OAuth client secret | — |
| `AMAZON_REFRESH_TOKEN` | Long-lived refresh token | — |
| `AMAZON_PROFILE_ID` | Default advertising profile scope | — |
| `AMAZON_ADVERTISING_API_URL` | SP API base URL | `https://advertising-api-eu.amazon.com` |
| `TARGET_ACOS` | Break-even ACOS (fraction) | `0.30` |
| `MIN_BID_AMOUNT` | Minimum keyword bid ($) | `0.25` |
| `MAX_BID_AMOUNT` | Maximum keyword bid ($) | `10.00` |
| `SESSION_SECRET` | express-session secret | (required in production) |

---

## Development

```bash
npm install
npm run start:dev      # NestJS watch mode
npm run docs:dev       # VitePress docs (http://localhost:5173)
npm run lint           # ESLint + Prettier fix
npm run test           # Jest unit tests
```

Prerequisites: MongoDB running on 27017, Redis running on 6379.

---

## Conventions

- **Engines are pure logic** — no I/O, no side effects, fully unit-testable.
- **OptimizationService** is the only place that calls Amazon API for mutations.
- **OptimizationLog** is written for every successful or failed bid/budget change.
- All API routes live under `/api/`; EJS-rendered pages live at root paths.
- NestJS global `AuthGuard` protects all routes; mark public routes with `@Public()` decorator.
- BullMQ jobs are the concurrency boundary — do not call OptimizationService directly from HTTP handlers.
